children: The DXY dollar rises, staying near a 19-month high, with the monetary policy outlook still working in its favor, UEXO.com's Louis Guy Detata says in a note. He refers to market pricing of a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December, and further increases throghout 2027. That said, "with a December hike almost fully priced in, the Fed minutes could carry more downside risk than upside potential for the dollar," he says. The Fed minutes are due at 1900 GMT. The DXY index rises 0.3% to 103.748 after earlier hitting a 19-month high of 103.858. (emese.bartha@wsj.com)
